title: Warm Smoky Sardinian Oyster Mushroom Skillet
description: A smoky and tender one-pot Italian dish featuring oyster mushrooms, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. The combination of Sardinian flavors and deep-fry-tod adds a unique twist to this skillet dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the oyster mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the cherry tomatoes and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or basil, if desired.
